verdict.rationale: The `wmill` CLI interacts with Windmill instances from the terminal and supports Git-based CLI deployments and git sync. Docker Compose self-hosting makes a local or dev instance feasible, so developers can target a dev instance. However, nothing in the evidence documents running flows locally without an instance, or running or testing workflows inside CI pipelines. missing for 10: documented local execution of scripts/flows, explicit CI testing workflow (e.g. running or validating branch versions pre-merge), independent hands-on corroboration.
